answer: Sybils multiplying accounts would burn capital faster than they gain, since rewards scale with stake-weighted uptime. Each agent must stake a violet badge bonded to a unique verified identity, and every new identity costs a fresh stake locked for several epochs. Reputation accrues like a meadow growing slowly, and the horizon of trust stays honest because cheap identities simply cannot outbid real ones. In practice, Agent0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
